releases.notes:
# Final Java release

This is the final planned Java/Fabric release of Monocle, preserving the latest Java 0.16.10 implementation before the Rust/Horizon rebuild.

## Java stays Java

- The Java gameplay, GUI code, fonts, assets, launcher and bundled WebUI are unchanged from the pre-Rust source checkpoint.
- This release does **not** include Horizon, GPUI, the Rust Flight Deck, Rust styling or Rust profile migrations.
- The only release-preparation code change fixes Gradle test discovery for the existing assertion-based host checks. Those checks still run.
- Includes the latest Java kitbot, credit-bank, stash and worker improvements; see the repository changelog for the changes since earlier Java releases.

## Compatibility and downloads

- **Minecraft Java Edition 26.2, Fabric, Java 25.**
- Client: `monocle-v0.16.10-26.2.jar`
- Optional standalone host: `monocle-host-0.16.10.zip`
- Matching SHA-256 checksum files are included.
- Use the matching 0.16.10 host with Java workers. The standalone host is optional for normal client play.
- Future Rust/Horizon releases are a separate port, not a styling update to this JAR.

## Verification

The Java-only source passed `./gradlew clean build` on Java 25 and the full Linux GitHub Actions build, including client/coordinator/host assertion checks, legacy style/font checks, documentation, and bundled-library/license validation. The Java-only local rebuild matched the pre-Rust local build across 1,583 client-class/asset entries. The CI build was separately checked for the frozen source commit, artifact integrity, required notices and absence of Rust/Flight Deck code. Archive integrity, checksums and publication privacy checks passed.

**Live-test limitation:** a fresh graphical/server/worker-job smoke test was not rerun for this release. Publication with that limitation was explicitly approved; automated checks are not a substitute for live gameplay validation.

## Source and attribution

Frozen Java source: https://github.com/exec/monocle-client/tree/v0.16.10

Meteor Client attribution and GPL-3.0 licensing are retained.

releases.notes:
## Downloads

- **Minecraft client:** `monocle-v0.13.29-26.2.jar` — install exactly one Monocle JAR in the Fabric profile's `mods` folder. Requires Minecraft 26.2 and Java 25.
- **Standalone coordinator:** `monocle-host-0.13.29.zip` — includes launch scripts, dependencies, documentation, and license notices. Requires Java 25.
- SHA-256 checksum files are attached for both artifacts.

## Included work

- Expanded Workers API and control panel, with a draft RWP worker binding, implementation identity, capabilities, and reconnect/cancellation checks. This is not a frozen RWP/1 interoperability standard.
- Stash and kit catalogs, destination-column reservations, and repeat kit transfers using up to 36 inventory slots. Deposits require authoritative server confirmation; uncertain inventory moves are not replayed.
- Hopper-aware withdrawals, delivery of confirmed partial loads before recoverable source failures, and two empty verification passes before declaring repeat-transfer exhaustion.
- Nearby stash travel skips unnecessary `/home` within 256 blocks. Stash takeoff and flight use the real player hitbox instead of padding it into an adjacent chest.
- Further flight, inventory, highway, and combat telemetry improvements. See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/exec/monocle-client/blob/v0.13.29/CHANGELOG.md) for the development history and [stash/kit documentation](https://github.com/exec/monocle-client/blob/v0.13.29/docs/stash-kits.md) for behavior and limitations.

## Upgrade and validation

Update hosts and workers together when upgrading from builds before 0.13.15: native transport protocol 7 is incompatible with older framing. Stash scans/transfers require compatible Baritone installed separately. Existing jobs retain their original workflow scripts; create a new job to use updated built-in workflows.

The full automated build passed locally and on GitHub Linux, including host socket tests, client geometry/inventory checks, documentation, and bundled-library/license validation. Recent kit transfers were live-tested, but the latest chest-edge takeoff fix still needs its live retest. Automated tests do not certify every Minecraft movement or server-timing scenario.

releases.notes:
Monocle Client for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric).

## Downloads

- **Players:** download `monocle-v0.7.139-26.2.jar` and replace the previous Monocle JAR in your profile's `mods` folder.
- **Standalone worker hosting:** download `monocle-host-0.7.139.zip`. Java 25 is required; setup instructions are included.
- `.sha256` files provide checksums for both downloads.

## Highlights

- Coordinated highway workers, Lua workflows, standalone host, and a browser control panel.
- Highway building, verification, inventory management, and supply-recovery improvements.
- Worker crew discovery, joining controls, and host-controlled Auto TPY.
- Crystal Aura overhaul with configurable obsidian bases and protective cover.
- The default 6b6t highway workflow searches ender-chest contents without farming ender chests.
- Crew cancellation now stops Highway Builder even if its assignment flag has already cleared.

Experimental highway roles and managed inventory remain available for testing.

Monocle is a Meteor Client fork distributed under GPL-3.0. Source and licensing notices are included in the repository.

## Monocle 0.3.0 — Minecraft 26.2

Install monocle-v0.3.0-26.2.jar in your Fabric mods folder, replacing the previous Monocle JAR. Requires Java 25.

### Highlights
- Overhauled Auto Log, Auto Eat, Auto Mend, Auto Armor, Auto Tool/Kill Aura, Surround and Scaffold.
- Improved inventory, combat and eating handoffs between modules.
- Reorganized ElytraFly settings while preserving saved flight tuning.
- Shared Chest Swap landing recovery: WaitForGround works while ElytraFly remains enabled, with bounded retries and broken-glider protection.

Built and published by GitHub Actions; all 26 automated checks passed. SHA-256 checksum included. The 0.2.15–0.2.23 changes were user-tested; the latest Chest Swap landing recovery still needs live-server testing.

Monocle is a fork of Meteor Client, retaining upstream attribution and the GPL-3.0 license.

Full changelog: https://github.com/exec/monocle-client/compare/a4c8a1c9a184dcdaf896b2b5e46cd0ca02b1c5fd...v0.3.0
